notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes:
We're more than excited to be able to (finally!) announce an exact release date! 

GeoGuessr Steam Edition will be available in store May 8! Let's go!!

notes.title: Update: Release coming in May!
notes.notes:
Roughly a month ago, we announced the news that GeoGuessr: Steam Edition was coming to, well, Steam! Along with the annoucement, we shared a bit of information as to what the edition was to include.

Based on your feedback, we realized that we needed to ensure a convenient way to link existing GeoGuessr browser accounts to Steam. To accommodate, the release date had to be pushed slightly, which is why we're writing this to let you know that instead of April, the game will be released in May. We'll keep you posted as soon as we have set a specific release date, stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555898/654900c5845d26fb68fe2e5cea7482db59d445b4.png

Recap:

 This edition focuses on Competitive Solo Duels as its main game mode
 The game comes with a Steam exlusive, free-to-play Amateur Division
 Unlimited Unranked Team Duels with Steam friends
 Subscribers on an Elite Yearly (browser) subscription will get full access
